knowledge:
- key_parameters: query.genes = Character vector of one or more cell type-specific marker genes (must use the same ID type as the dataset, e.g., Entrez or probeset IDs) ;; alpha = SVD-based pre-processing filter strength, ranging from 1 (no filter) to 0 (strong filter), default is 0.5 ;; query-driven weight = Logical indicating whether to apply a query-driven weight filter, default is TRUE.
- alternatives: None mentioned.
- when_to_use: When identifying genes specifically expressed in a cell type of interest using large, heterogeneous microarray datasets (ideally >500 samples), even if the cell type has not been isolated.
- pitfalls: Using poor quality query genes (a single highly specific marker is better than multiple markers of questionable specificity) ;; Query genes must be strictly specific to the cell type within the context of the dataset (e.g., brain-specific for brain datasets, organism-wide specific for general datasets) ;; Running CMprep on large datasets (>1000 arrays) is computationally expensive and can take over an hour.

workflows.name: preprocessed_data_search
workflows.intent: Predict cell type-specific gene expression using pre-processed datasets from CellMapperData.
input: query (Entrez ID of the marker gene)
workflows.stages: 1. Load pre-processed data from ExperimentHub ;; 2. Define query gene(s) ;; 3. Run co-expression search using CMsearch ;; 4. Inspect top results.
workflows.code:
library("ExperimentHub")
hub <- ExperimentHub()
BrainAtlas <- hub[["EH170"]]
library(CellMapper)
query <- "2571"
GABAergic <- CMsearch(BrainAtlas, query.genes = query)
head(GABAergic)

Engreitz <- hub[["EH171"]]
Lukk <- hub[["EH172"]]
ZhengBradley <- hub[["EH173"]]
query2 <- "3856"
SimpleEpithelia <- CMsearch(list(Engreitz, Lukk, ZhengBradley), query.genes = query2)
head(SimpleEpithelia)

workflows.name: custom_data_search
workflows.intent: Prepare custom microarray expression data and predict cell type-specific gene expression.
input: ALL (ExpressionSet object or matrix of expression data with genes as rows and samples as columns)
query.genes (Affymetrix probeset ID or gene identifier matching the dataset)
workflows.stages: 1. Load custom expression dataset ;; 2. Pre-process the dataset using CMprep ;; 3. Define query gene(s) ;; 4. Run co-expression search using CMsearch.
workflows.code:
library(ALL)
data(ALL)
prepped.data <- CMprep(ALL)
out <- CMsearch(prepped.data, query.genes = "1000_at")
head(out)
